name: codegraph
description: CodeGraph: Advanced visual dry-run code execution visualizer for Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('node', ['server/server.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.install-all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
